problem: Object.freeze is presented as a full stop to changes, but it is shallow: properties of a nested object can still be changed after freezing the outer one.
fix: Say: Object.freeze(o) stops adding, changing or deleting o's own properties; it is shallow, so objects held inside o can still change.
